edges.evidence: cnn-vision explains VGG's depth limit ('~20 layers due to vanishing gradients') and ResNet's skip connections ('The identity shortcut gives gradients a direct path back to early layers') through gradient flow, which it does not teach.

The workflow code uses model.eval() with torch.no_grad(), quantize_dynamic on torch.nn.Linear, torch.save(quantized_model.state_dict(), ...) and a teacher.eval() distillation loop over train_loader.
